bio: Originally from King Drive, but the 600 never fully accepted him.
Paralyzed from a shooting and uses a wheelchair.
A longtime friend of King Von.
An OG and one of the highest-earning gangsters in South Chicago.
Killed Zio and Kamikazi Mazi at a party before being killed days later.
Very close to Dell.
Participated in a revenge killing days after his prison release, when most believed Keke had killed Lil Jojo.
Killed by a friend from Dipset after a dispute at a party; his death sparked a war between Brick$quad and Dipset. Earlier, he and Kelles racketed Cortize of TYMB.
Racketed Lil Reese of Lamron.
Creator of D-Block (Dope Block).
Originally a Black Disciple before switching to Insane Gangster Disciples. Had a personal dispute with 600Breezy and triggered the feud with FBG.
Racketed Cortize of TYMB alongside Aiki.

Originally a Travelling Vice Lord. Known for repeatedly trolling O'Block by posting photos of himself in O'Block buildings. Had a personal dispute with D.Rose and urinated on Odee's grave. Close to Aiki and Lil Jojo. Shot BCity of Central City 15 times in 2012, including multiple headshots; BCity survived.
One of Lamron's first members, close with Lil Law, Lil Durk, and Lil Reese. Switched to Brick$quad 069 after Lamron killed a family member.
Known for knocking out Lil Durk at school.
Killed in 2019 outside his home after a woman set him up. Close to Lil Jojo.

Launched the BDK movement, shifting alliances into conflict. Invented BDK Friday, when he and others beat Black Disciples at school on Fridays. Regularly racketed and targeted J-Roc of Lamron. Habitually beat Lil Reese at Robeson school alongside P.Rico, Smylez, and Hittz.
Habitually beat Lil Reese of Lamron at Robeson school with Lil Jojo, Smylez, and Hittz.
Close to Lil Don.
Chris World set was created in his honor. The set became rivals with TYMB. Despite their rival sets, he was friends with FBG Young.
TYMB was created in his honor. Close with Pac Man of Dro City and many Lamron members.
Dedicated by Chief Keef. Beaten by police during an arrest.
Close to SMB Poo Poo. Kidnapped, stripped, racketed, and killed OJ and Lil D of Jaro City with SMB Poo Poo, leaving them near train tracks.
Triggered the war with STL/EBT.
Originally a Black Disciple before switching. Close to 051 Young Money; before prison was close with O'Block. Lil Moe of Lamron taught him to shoot.
Obama World set was created in his honor.
Racketed Lil Reese of Lamron.
Was close with T-Roy of O'Block. Set up Cdai of the 600 in an attempt to kill him.
Very close to Bankroll Q. Shot at LA Capone's first memorial at Front$treet alongside another 051 member.
Racketed the chain from Billionaire Black of STL/EBT alongside Millz.
